title: La relève — rénovation complète de la grange en espace de culture professionnel
status: current concept-art; not integrated into the application
userDirection: Rénover intégralement l'intérieur de l'ancienne grange avant la culture. Aspect professionnel. Aucune culture dans une étable conservée.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised four-panel illustrated storyboard for the fictional Kanab Quest game's tutorial, landscape 1536x1024, opaque.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET: the first four-panel storyboard. Keep the exact same charming Sylvain mascot identity, warm illustrated Breton art style, dark confident contours, cream gutters and four-panel layout. Preserve top-left arrival composition with the old Breton stone barn, turquoise doors and Sylvain offering the brass key. The other THREE panels must be substantially redesigned.
CRITICAL USER CORRECTION: The entire former cattle barn is COMPLETELY REFURBISHED inside before any plants are grown. The finished interior must unmistakably look like a professional modern indoor cultivation facility. ALL rustic livestock fixtures, straw, feeding troughs, timber stalls, crates, rough stone walls, exposed wooden roof beams, dirt floors and farmhouse workshop decor disappear from all interior panels. It is NOT a few plants added to an old stable. Keep the rural exterior ONLY in top-left.
Top-right: conversion finished, before growing. Sylvain in clean teal work overalls and his recognizable teal/ochre cap holds a clipboard and tape measure, laying out zones in a fully renovated bright room. Entire interior has smooth off-white insulated wall panels, a finished clean white ceiling, continuous light-grey resin floor, neat cable trays, orderly ventilation ducts, fitted teal-trim access doors. A substantial technical room ready for fit-out, not an operating hospital. No plants, no harvested flowers, no drying products yet. One simple floor plan on his clipboard, WITHOUT readable text. Modern ceiling light and clean panel seams establish professional quality. Every part of the room, including the background, is fully refurbished.
Bottom-left: same finished professional growing chamber now in operation. Two modest, organized grow zones with consistent black plant containers on tidy modular metal benches, healthy stylized green hemp plants beneath broad LINEAR LED light bars suspended evenly from a neat ceiling frame. White clean wall panels and clean floor throughout, orderly wall-mounted environmental control unit and ventilation, sensible clear walking aisle, wiring contained in cable trays. Several plants but do not fill the entire 100 square metre building: expanding planted area remains a later game decision, all of the ROOM is already professionally renovated. Sylvain stands in the aisle with a variety card or clipboard; keep cap and friendly recognizable face. No pendant domestic lamps, no wooden tables, no wood panels, no stone, no straw, no drying racks mixed among living plants, no jars beside plants. This is a management-game visual, not a technical cultivation blueprint: no dimensions, recipes, parameter readouts or horticultural instructions.
Bottom-right: dedicated clean preparation and dispatch room, SEPARATE from the growing chamber, within the same converted building. Sylvain at a clean pale metal workbench presents a sealed unbranded paper packet beside a receipt and the old farm ledger, now the administrative object on the clean side of the desk. Neat metal storage shelving with closed jars and tidy sealed stock, a professional weighing scale, opaque smooth wall panels, a closed teal-trim door with a small observation window showing a glimpse of the orderly grow room behind. Clearly organized production and storage. No loose flowers on the desk, no wooden counter, no exterior open door straight into the cultivation room. Celebrate the first fictional delivery with a warm satisfied expression, no cash pile.
Professional architecture and equipment must be immediately readable even as thumbnail. Keep visual consistency with the input mascot and illustrated style: bold black-green ink outlines, cream/off-white/teal/turquoise and warm ochre accents, restrained halftone. Bright clean lighting, contemporary indoor cultivation, cartoon game art, not photorealism or glossy 3D. Fully preserve Sylvain's face and recognizable head proportions. No extra people. No titles, labels, numbers, writing, speech bubbles, UI, logos or watermarks. Artwork only. Four scenes in correct order: arrival outside; fully renovated empty room and planning; professional grow room in operation; separate professional packing room.
